system.summary: Smarts; 8 Blunt; Close (5 ft). Deployable and Trap, as for the Bear Trap: an enemy moving toward its hex must pass a CR 2 Wit Check to go around, or it stumbles in and sets it off. Explosive (C): every enemy within 5 ft (Close) of the target also takes the damage.

automation.note: Deployable and Trap: place the mine on a hex. An enemy moving toward it makes a CR 2 Wit Check. On a success it goes around; on a failure the mine deals 8 Blunt to it and to every enemy within Close Range (5 ft) of it. There is no Strike roll, so apply the damage by hand.
